scope: Static design/code/metadata review only. No arrays, labels, fit, score, download, network or final-artifact access in this review. Root retains numerical allocation.
verdict: A distinct, bounded test of fixed ARR-supervised augmentation is defensible after the prospective clarifications below. No current evidence establishes taxi-out CV improvement, marginal v80 headroom, or a several-second gain.

novelty.distinction: Additional training-date ARR labels supervising shared motion coefficients; prior screen used only DEP point labels. This does not reopen shared arrival clock drift, scalar stand lag, paired endpoints or DEP-only loss-weight tuning.

findings.evidence: March/September/October/November belong to intersection of tuning_seasonal.FOLDS. Only fit-side ARR labels train each temporal direction; no Jan/Jul or ranking values. Query/point selection, ID-hash cap and geometry are persisted before targets; exact source-observation overlap and movementID overlap are guarded.
findings.limitation: These dates are not claimed never previously inspected elsewhere. The internal transfer test is not fresh challenge CV.

findings.decision: pass as designed; implementation proof required
findings.evidence: DEP taxi-side sigmoid(point-offblock)/30 and ARR sigmoid(inblock-point)/30 have consistent moving-side orientation. Inputs omit BLOCK, taxi, original clock channels14/15, movement-relative time and point ordinal. Fixed movement-anchored windows are input-defined.
findings.limitation: Recorded BLOCK is noisy and is not an independent physical boundary. Legacy ARR cache uses target>=0 then NULL otherwise; design now preserves and reports this rather than silently recovering labels.

findings.evidence: ARR radial derivative alone changes sign. Pairs remain adjacent original retained slots, both ground/speed-known, with0<dt<=120; no bridge over rejected airborne slots. Known other movement anchors exclude contaminated windows before labels.
findings.limitation: Direction normalization is not exact time reversal; different phase windows/coverage may remain detectable. Absence of another observed movement does not prove no unobserved rotation.

findings.evidence: 50/50 policy halves DEP contribution and adds equal normalized ARR mass, preserving nominal total loss mass andL2. Original DEP objective is not unchanged. Candidate motion12/control intercept+airport10 diagnostic is fixed before data and uses no extra fit.
findings.limitation: The no-fit coefficient swap is a parameterized counterfactual, not a complete causal decomposition. A primary pass without loss improvement from that diagnostic in BOTH directions is mechanism_inconclusive, not grounds to expand solely on representation claims.

findings.evidence: At least5% DEP soft-label BCE improvement and negative upper paired-day95% interval in both directions, plus motion-only qualification. Both arms use identical held flights.
findings.limitation: Only six day clusters per direction; conditional bootstrap is imprecise and reused development evidence. Boundary BCE does not imply taxi RMSE improvement. A pass can justify one separately frozen matched Jan/Jul test; no automatic production or final change.

findings.decision: planning cap plausible after prospective cap, not benchmarked
findings.evidence: Input-only SHA256 selection limits5000 flights/phase/half; at most1,280,000 training points/split. 22 float64 features are225.28MB before buffers; streamed512-flight evaluation avoids decoding all evaluation features at once.
findings.limitation: Preparation, temporary dataframe copies, optimizer buffers and actual wall time still need bounded implementation/measurement;2GB/5min are stop limits, not demonstrated costs.

prospective_changes_reviewed: Added unchanged-nuisance no-fit motion diagnostic and qualified advancement.
Preserved original slot adjacency; clarified raw radial metres/sign handling.
Preserved legacy ARR negative-target NULL semantics and raw/cache audit.
Added input-ID hash cap before labels with no replacement and post-cap finite-label coverage>=500.
implementation_requirements_before_numer: Pin and verify actual input identities, raw allowed-date projections, units and exact cached/raw label-null agreement.
Synthetic poison-label tests must keep selected IDs/features/point weights/hash sampling bit-exact; label function alone changes.
Independent features/phase/adjacency/objective-gradient/weights/partition fixtures; no pre-existing encoded clock feature may enter.
Compute coverage separately for input-eligible, sampled, finite-label and held populations; fail before fitting if gates fail.
All four model/fit receipts and held predictions saved before evaluation summaries; no post-result retry or tuning.
Independent numeric audit of actual result and honest Jan/Jul successor remain separate root allocations.
